key_insight: Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO) turns Policy Mirror Descent into a trajectory-level reinforcement learning objective for autoregressive LLMs, avoiding intermediate state-value estimation while preserving the same unique optimum.
engineering_relevance: This offers a simpler critic-free training recipe for reward-verifiable reasoning models, reducing implementation complexity in math-focused LLM optimization.
method: Derive a trajectory-level objective from Bellman equations for terminal-reward generation.
Approximate the objective to obtain a practical BPO loss.
Use a smoothed ratio of complementary token probabilities as the mismatch-correction weight.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks showing that BPO is effective.
watch_item: The practical gain depends on how well the objective approximation and mismatch-correction weight behave during training, so stability and sensitivity may need careful tuning.
